Scope:

Import: app/api/cyrus/import/** , lib/cyrus/import/** , lib/cyrus/zip.ts , services/modbuilder/import.js (and any zip/jar reader): zip bombs (is uncompressed size capped per entry and in total, entry count capped, nested zips/jars recursion depth, compression ratio), zip-slip (../ or absolute or backslash entry names when extracting), symlink entries, duplicate entry names (first vs last wins disagreement between scanner and loader), quarantine (is the imported jar quarantined/scanned before it can be delivered?), attestation bypass (can the user claim authorship/licence or skip the scan via a request field?). Prompt injection: does imported mod text (plugin.yml descriptions, lang files) flow into any LLM prompt?
2. Library: app/api/cyrus/library/v2/** (browse, file/[token], report, url, use), app/api/cyrus/assets/v1/library/** (upload, use, png), lib/cyrus/library/** , lib/cyrus/texture-library : contribution filters (NSFW/brand/licence filters: can they be bypassed by case, unicode homoglyphs, zero-width chars?), takedown (does a takedown by hash also block re-upload of the same file with one byte changed / different metadata; is the hash computed over the bytes actually served?), report abuse (flooding), signed file tokens (HMAC compare constant-time? expiry checked? bound to user? token reuse; path traversal inside token payload), library metadata flowing into LLM prompts (prompt injection via titles/tags of community entries -> catalog tool picks).
3. Pack hosting: lib/cyrus/packhost/** and any pack URL signing: signature scheme, expiry, constant-time compare, can one user fetch another's pack.
4. Sound library gating: grep CYRUS_SOUND_LIBRARY_CLEARED. Verify that proprietary/library sound audio is NEVER served raw (incl. app/api/cyrus/assets/v1/sound/preview, candidates routes, library file route, pack builds) unless that flag is set; check whether the default is fail-closed (unset/empty/"0"/"false"), and whether any route serves raw bytes from /tank/cyrus-library-staging or sound/nxeon-proprietary regardless of the flag.

For each finding give: severity (high/medium/low/info), file:line, a concrete trace (input -> code path -> effect), "VERIFIED by reading" or "UNVERIFIED (why)", and a minimal fix suggestion. Also list things you checked that are SAFE (one line each). Keep the whole report under 800 words.

input.message:
Read-only audit of /tank/dev-worktrees/cyrus-r32. Nothing was run, built or edited. I found no high-severity issues, and the import and sound-gating paths are well defended. The main gaps are in library moderation.

## Findings

**1. MEDIUM: one account can mass-hold published library assets through "legal" reports.**
- Where: `lib/cyrus/library/backend/moderation.ts` (`report()`, the `if (legal || reporters >= 3)` branch) and `http.ts` `handleReport` (limit 20 per minute per user).
- Trace: a signed-in viewer POSTs `{id, reason:"copyright"}`. A single legal-reason report moves a published asset to `held`, so `canServe` answers 404 for everyone. The viewer needs no paid plan. Looping over ids from browse holds about 20 assets per minute, and three sockpuppet accounts hold anything with a non-legal reason.
- Status: VERIFIED by reading.
- Fix: require a minimum account age or plan for legal reports, and cap total open reports per reporter per day. Keep the asset published (flagged) until a second distinct reporter or owner review.

**2. MEDIUM: takedown does not cascade to near-duplicate copies.**
- Where: `moderation.ts` `takedown()` and `lib/cyrus/library/backend/contribute.ts` near-duplicate step.
- Trace: a near-duplicate of a published asset is stored as published with `duplicateOf: near.id`. If the original is taken down, `takedown()` only touches that one id. The copy stays published and is now the visible one.
- Exact bytes are blocked (id is the sha256 of the bytes, and an existing `removed` row returns "blocked"). Near-copies of an already-removed asset are caught at contribute time and held.
- Coverage gaps in the fingerprints: audio uses env64 (WAV only, so OGG gets no fingerprint), models match on exact facts, images use dhash within Hamming distance 6. A flip or crop evades the image check.
- Status: VERIFIED by reading.
- Fix: on takedown, also remove or hold every entry whose `duplicateOf` is that id. Add an OGG/Vorbis fingerprint.

**3. MEDIUM/LOW: content filters see only text, and they are bypassable.**
- Where: `lib/cyrus/library/v2/filters.ts` and `vocab.ts:76` (`words()`).
- Trace: `words()` lowercases, then splits on `[^a-z0-9]+` with no NFKC normalisation or confusable folding. So `аdult` (Cyrillic a) becomes `dult`, `ad<ZWSP>ult` becomes `ad ult`, and `n4ked` becomes `n 4 ked`, none of which match a word-list entry. Matching is also whole-word only.
- No pixel or audio classifier exists, so the filters only look at the key, tags and path. A hostile PNG with a clean key is auto-published.
- Reachability today: the only wired contributor is the texture studio (`studios/service.ts:301`), and its `name` is the key, which is constrained to `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,31}$`. So the unicode bypass is not reachable now, but leetspeak and synonyms are. It would become reachable if another contributor is wired or the key regex is relaxed.
- Status: VERIFIED by reading.
- Fix: NFKC plus confusable folding plus zero-width stripping before `words()`, with an optional squashed-string match. Add image and audio classification, or hold all first-time contributors' assets for review.

**4. LOW: the licence claim on imports is accepted unverified.**
- Where: `lib/cyrus/import/attestation.ts` (`effectiveLicence`).
- Trace: a tick box, a typed name and `claimedLicence` are all the check. If the files name no licence, the claim alone becomes the effective licence. Public sharing also needs explicit consent, and today `sharing.allowed` is hard-false in `viewOf`.
- Status: VERIFIED by reading.
- Fix: when only the claim exists, require manual review before any public share.

**5. LOW: no unicode normalisation on the duplicate-path check.**
- Where: `ingest.ts` `vetArchive` folds case only, and `services/modbuilder/import.js` `SEG_OK` is ASCII-only.
- Trace: the service side refuses any non-ASCII path, so there is no real scanner/loader disagreement. The portal accepts such names but only holds them in memory.
- Status: VERIFIED.

**6. INFO: pack hosting has no signing, by design.**
- Where: `lib/cyrus/packhost/*` and `app/p/[file]/route.ts`.
- Trace: packs are public, unauthenticated, immutable objects at `p/<sha1>.zip`. The sha1 is the only capability, so any user who knows the hash can fetch a pack. There is no signature, expiry or per-user binding. `put` is first-writer-wins, so a chosen-prefix SHA-1 collision could pre-seed a victim's URL, which is theoretical. `inspectPackZip` reads the central directory only and checks name safety plus `pack.mcmeta`.
- Status: VERIFIED.
- Fix: if packs must stay private, use per-pack random keys or signed URLs. Otherwise state that packs are public.

**7. INFO: imported source text reaches the builder model unquoted.**
- Where: `services/modbuilder/prompts.js` `importChangePrompt`.
- Trace: the plugin.yml description (300 chars) goes into `spec.summary`, but the imported-change prompt does not include `spec.summary`, so it never reaches the model. Docs (README, LICENSE) are saved as "QUOTED DATA, NOT INSTRUCTIONS" with the end marker stripped. Java comments and resource strings are read by the model by design. This is mitigated by `-proc:none`, the file allowlist and the scan.
- Status: VERIFIED for the paths read. Whether `spec.summary` reaches the model through another route is UNVERIFIED, because I did not trace all consumers.

**8. INFO: `useCatalogAsset` copies non-proprietary sound originals into the project.**
- Where: `lib/cyrus/library/backend/use.ts`.
- Trace: only `proprietary-nxeon` is rendered rather than copied. CC0, CC-BY and user-contributed audio is copied raw, which is licence-appropriate. `canServe` blocks raw audio over URLs regardless.
- Status: VERIFIED.

## Checked and SAFE
- **Zip limits:** `ingest.ts` and `inventory/zipread.ts` cap entries (5000), per-entry size (8 MB), total inflated size (96 MB) and ratio (100 per entry, 40 for the archive), refuse zip64, and use a shared budget across nested archives.
- **Zip extraction safety:** `inflateRawSync` runs with `maxOutputLength=usize`, and CRC is checked. Nesting is capped at 2 levels and 64 archives. Path-traversal names, absolute names, backslashes, NUL and control characters are refused. Symlink entries, encrypted entries and exact or case-folded duplicate names are refused.
- **Service re-validation:** `services/modbuilder/import.js` re-validates the same rules independently, plus a magic-byte check on classes, a base64 regex and `writeFiles` with the `wx` flag and a resolved-prefix check. Dependencies are an allowlist verified by sha256 before every compile.
- **Import quarantine:** raw bytes are stored first (0600 file in a 0700 directory, opaque ids), never served or extracted, and only the build service compiles them.
- **Scan profile:** the "attested" scan profile is set server-side by the build service, not by any request field.
- **Import route:** `POST /api/cyrus/import` sits behind a fail-closed flag, a verified-email check, three rate limits and an in-flight cap.
- **Signed library file tokens** (`signed-url.ts`): HMAC-SHA256 with `timingSafeEqual`. Expiry, `iat` skew and the max TTL (900 s) are checked. The token is bound to an opaque viewer HMAC, the secret must be at least 32 characters, the id is 64 hex and the variant is a whitelist. There is no path in the payload. `handleFile` re-runs `canServe`, so a removal gives 410 immediately.
- **Object and staging reads:** the object store verifies the sha256 on every read. `StagingSource` is realpath-confined, rejects `..` and absolute paths, and sha256-checks the file.
- **Sound gating:** every site reads `CYRUS_SOUND_LIBRARY_CLEARED === "1"` (`flags.ts:39`, `sound/host.ts:82`, `api/v1/deps.ts:60`, `assets/request.ts`, `sync.ts`), so unset, empty, "0" and "false" all fail closed.
  - Sound preview (`sound-service.ts:194`) and use (`sound-http.ts:127`) refuse when the flag is not set.
  - Build and sync paths pass `library: false` to `checkReturnedSound` unless the flag is set.
  - `canServe` never serves raw sound or music, only `preview-ogg@1`. It never serves a proprietary original or bundle, and any proprietary preview needs the flag.
  - No route serves `/tank/cyrus-library-staging` bytes except through `canServe` and the confined `StagingSource`. I found no reference to `nxeon-proprietary` in code.
- **Ownership checks:** `/library/asset/:id/png` and the studio `library/use` handler check project ownership.
- **Title sanitisation:** community titles pass through `words()`, `humanTitle` and `slugTag`, so they are at most 80 ASCII alphanumeric characters. `describeEntry` builds the description from fixed templates and does not pass the title through as free text. Prompt injection through catalog titles is therefore limited to ordinary words.
- **Report abuse:** reports are deduplicated per (asset, reporter).

**Not read:** `lib/cyrus/library/v2/stage-b.ts` and `stage-c.ts`, the admin routes, and `lib/cyrus/studios/sound-http.ts` beyond the lines quoted.
